source: Instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC (Rev. December 2026), Specific Instructions for Form 1099-NEC, box 1a
note: Box 1a reads 'Enter nonemployee compensation (NEC) of $2,000 or more', and the four conditions under 'What is NEC?' end with 'You made payments to the payee of at least $2,000 during the year.' Below it the form is not required; it is still made, and says so.
